channel.title: The Box Plus Network - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Box Plus Network (boxplus.com)

item.title: Israel launches new attacks on Iran and expands incursion into southern Lebanon
item.description: On day four of the war, Israeli troops are back in southern Lebanon, Iranian drones are striking across the Gulf, markets across the world are taking fright as oil and gas prices spike upwards.

item.title: Trump deepens criticism of UK saying Starmer ‘not Churchill’
item.description: President Trump has intensified his criticism of Sir Keir Starmer and the UK's approach to the military action in the Gulf. The US President said: “This is not Winston Churchill that we’re dealing with."

item.title: Trump boasts US has ‘militarily beaten’ Iran
item.description: President Trump has offered a bullish assessment of progress so far in Iran, saying the US has "knocked out" many naval and air targets and that Iran was "beaten militarily."

item.title: Trump ‘well within his right’ to strike Iran – former US national security advisor
item.description: Krishnan Guru-Murthy speaks to H.R. McMaster - a National Security Advisor during President Trump's first term - he was asked whether the US President was right to start this war without congressional approval.

item.title: There are ‘consequences’ for Gulf states who host US bases – Iranian professor
item.description: Krishnan Guru-Murthy speaks to Mohammad Marandi, a professor at Tehran University, a former adviser to Iran's nuclear negotiating team and close to the authorities there - he was asked how he thinks the Iranian military strategy is playing out.

item.title: Israeli troops cross into Lebanon amid fears of wider war
item.description: On day four of the war on Iran, Israel's action against Lebanon has continued from the air - with further strikes in Beirut and elsewhere - and on the ground, with Israeli ground troops pressing deeper into the south of the country.

item.title: Iran can’t cope with ‘American strength’ – former Israeli commander who led Iran desk
item.description: We speak to Asaf Cohen, the former head of the Iran desk in the Intelligence Directorate of the Israel Defense Forces.

item.title: Chancellor tries to reassure markets amid war in Middle East
item.description: Those impacts are increasingly looking quite serious, as oil and gas rise in price, the cost of government borrowing goes up and stock markets go down.

item.title: Starmer has the ‘right judgment’ on Iran – Treasury minister
item.description: We were joined by Exchequer Secretary to the Treasury, Dan Tomlinson.

item.title: ‘I feel let down by my government’ – son of Brit detained in Iran
item.description: The notorious Evin Jail in Tehran has been an instrument of terror where the Iranian government has held dissidents, journalists, and foreigners, ever since the Islamic Revolution. Inmates have described torture, overcrowding, and the constant fear of rape or execution.
